title: Tourism and Cultural Preservation: Balancing Access and Authenticity
prompt: In many historic cities, the growth of tourism has brought income for conservation but has also been blamed for turning local traditions into staged performances for visitors. Some people argue that tourism inevitably damages the authenticity of local culture, while others believe that tourism can be a powerful incentive for communities to preserve and celebrate their heritage. To what extent do you agree or disagree that tourism is a threat to cultural authenticity? In your essay, discuss both the pressures tourism places on local culture and the ways it may help sustain cultural traditions, and state clearly your own position on whether the benefits outweigh the risks. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为雅思学术类 Task 2 模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先准确理解题目要求：你需要就“旅游是否威胁文化真实性”表明立场，并同时讨论旅游对当地文化的压力与可能的保护作用。写作时请确保：明确回应题目中的两个讨论方向（压力与保护），在引言中表明自己的立场，主体段落用具体理由和例子展开，结论重申观点。注意字数不少于250词，建议用约40分钟完成。请勿背诵模板，重点练习论证的平衡性与立场的一致性。
